script.quote: The program which follows demonstrates a basic timing circuit using the turning of the rotary switch dial between two points to generate a periodic signal.

note: Step 7 speculative fixture (derivation A). Every assert is derived by hand from the 17-wire topology and the p.3 rule (the dial turns between two points; slide switches 4 and 5 choose among four periods), not from printed dial positions or periods; the page prints neither. Topology: D1 is on minus (6G/D1, 6G/6N, 6N/6-); 5S is on plus (5S/6K, 6J/6K, 6J/6+); the slides route 5S to one live contact: both LEFT D3, 4 RIGHT D5, 5 RIGHT D7, both RIGHT D9. The wiper D16 feeds the coil at 6E. Relay 6 released: D17 +, D18 -, dial turns up; on the live contact the coil pulls in, the transfer puts D17 -, D18 +, dial turns down, and the coil holds through 6K-6L-6C, lamp 6 and 6E; on D1 the coil is shorted, relay 6 releases and the dial turns up again. So relay 6 encodes direction (nc up, no down) and the dial runs D1 to the live contact and back: arcs of 2, 4, 6 and 8 pitches. The absolute sense (D17 + / D18 - toward increasing numbers) is the O-R11 ruling, [likely]; the first until fails under the opposite sense, which would oscillate the long way D3..D15..D1 and never visit D2. Encoding (O-C14, no direction observable): each until pairs a dial contact with relay 6, so (cN, nc) is the wiper heading up and (cN, no) heading down. Reaching the live contact is shown by (top, nc); turning there by (top-1, no) within 300 ms of it, which a live contact two positions higher (the next possible top) cannot meet: four more pitches is 333 ms at the 45 rpm run-rate fallback (O-R3). The correct path is 50-180 ms depending on the overrun model (O-R5, coast_udeg_drive_removed 20 deg as a worst case); it is a timing window resting on those fallbacks, not a printed timing. Every slide move is made at a stated phase (right after an until match) so its outcome is fixed by hand: slide break at 27 ms of the 60 ms stroke lands before the wiper's next contact (83 ms). The move 4 LEFT at D8 heading up (top D9 to D7) produces the long-way wraparound the Step 7 notes record, asserted through D12; the move 5 LEFT is made heading down so no wraparound follows. Lamp 6: on in series with the held coil (about 46 mA, about 790 milli by the lamp_pwl law), off when relay 6 is released between contacts. Not asserted: the period values themselves, lamp 6 on the live contact before pull-in (a pull-in of about 12 ms against a 40 ms filament), and the D1 dwell. Start position D0 and slides LEFT are construction defaults, not printed. Rotary geometry, run rate and coast remain profile fallbacks O-R1, O-R3 and O-R5.
